title: Sordland/Turn01/InT_Infrastructure

Gus Manger has ties to construction firms in Holsord and Gelsland and Lileas Graf is friends with the mayor of Arvory Eric Niel. Symon Holl specifically wants to focus on infrastructure projects first because they tend to show quick and visible results. He hopes that these will prove his efficiency in providing an economic recovery.

title: Sordland/Turn02/SnO_SecurityOverview
description:
Iosef Lancea and Valken Kruger give you a Defense Briefing talking about the Armed Forces of Sordland and each branch in detail. They then expand on the possible external threats of Rumburg and maybe even Valgsland. 

Lileas Graf and Nia Morgna talk about the law, justice system and the interior ministry. Details about several branches tied to the Interior come up. The internal security situation becomes clear.

If not this is not available and the player defaults to Turn02_Admin_Media_Influence = false. In this conversation the player is invited to a country club in Conriat owned by the Heart of Sordland Conglomerate. Joined by Lucian Galade and Petr Vectern they travel to the location thanks to the driver Serge Wolkner. Here an ethically/morally questionable deal is presented by Marcel. The player accepts or declines.

title: Sordland/Turn02/InT_HighwayContract
description: This conversation is available if the President has chosen to build the H-3 Highway. The intracies of this project is that it strengthens Lileas Graf's political connection Eric Niel the mayor of Arvory. Also the S.S.C. company. It avoids Laren and other villages away from the coast thus not fixing the infrastructure situation entirely. The advantages are heightened trade with Agnolia and more business investment in the region. This will lift people out of poverty. Symon Holl is neutral in his advocation. There is a choice between giving the contract and then the project responsibility to Symon or Lileas Graf.

title: Sordland/Turn02/InT_RailwayContract
description: This conversation is available if the President has chosen to build the L-1 Highspeed Rail. The intracies of this project is that it avoids Erlory which is very negative for that city and its economic connectivity. It bolsters Gus Mangers position and his construction company ally Underhall to take contracts. The advantages are trickling rural development up to Holsord and through Anrica, Gelsord and other villages in between. The increase of the speed of travel for passengers and logistics alike. Symon Holl advises to take the ministry approved firms. There is a choice between giving the contract and then project responsibility to Symon or Gus.

title: Sordland/Turn03/EnT_Budget
description: Symon Holl arranges a cabinet meeting for the government budget. Election promises are laid out and and a debate over what to invest where is made. Each minister strongly makes their position clear. The player is forced to make a balancing act between following election promises, keeping the cabinet satisfied and making a balanced budget. This is a major economic turning point with political outcomes.
